svg.aria-label: Two stacked bars over 1,804 PLOD-CW gold long-form spans. The upper bar partitions them: 57.65 % reached by the Schwartz & Hearst family, 21.95 % added by non-S&H proposers, 20.40 % reached by no proposer at all. The lower bar decomposes the 42.35 % the family misses on a different axis: 34.98 % of all gold long forms, 631 spans, are cleanly alignable with a gold short form in the same passage and are highlighted as pairs no bracket scanner offers; the remaining 7.37 % are not. The highlighted band cuts across the upper bar rather than slicing it, and at least 263 of its spans are already reached by a non-S&H proposer. Run ids: monoculture.plod_all.gold.long_form.overlap.class.
